copy.heroTitle:
여섯 개의 우연,
한 편의 영화.
copy.heroSub: BytePlus Seed Family가 나만의 영화 포스터와 트레일러를 만들어 드려요.
copy.posterNotice: Seedream이 당신의 포스터를 그립니다. 완성된 포스터와 트레일러는 감독 이름과 함께 부스 스크린에 자동으로 상영돼요.
copy.consentPrivacy:
수집 항목: 휴대폰 번호 · 감독 이름
이용 목적: 체험 결과(포스터·트레일러) 재조회, 이벤트 참여 확인
보관 기간: 행사 종료 후 30일 이내 파기
동의를 거부할 수 있으나, 이 경우 체험에 참여할 수 없습니다.
copy.consentMarketing: BytePlus · Seedance 신제품 소식과 이벤트 안내를 카카오톡/문자로 받아봅니다.

genres.style: grounded live-action action film, shot on 35mm anamorphic, practical stunts and real fire, sweat, dust and grit on skin and clothes, low-angle hero framing, slight motion blur
looks: warm firelight and sodium-vapor orange against cool dusk blue
bleach-bypass steel grey and gunmetal, one hard white key light and a single red accent
sun-bleached bone, sand and rust tones under hard overhead light with crisp black shadows
acid green and deep black, lit by flickering fluorescent tubes and emergency strobes

electric blue and magenta neon reflected on wet asphalt, deep violet shadows
dusty ochre and olive drab with shafts of pale light cutting through smoke
icy cyan and white breath-fog cold with a few small hot-orange embers
genres.motion: the hero moves with force and purpose, real dust and sparks drifting past, quick but physically believable action

camera.text: a low-angle tracking shot racing alongside the hero
a fast 180-degree orbit around the hero mid-action
a speed ramp: real-time motion slowing into dramatic slow motion at the peak moment
a handheld whip pan that snaps onto the action
a crane down from high above as dust and debris settle
a drone shot rising fast from ground level to reveal the whole scene
a fast lateral truck shot sliding past foreground objects, parallax wiping across the frame
a rapid pull-back from the hero's face to a wide shot of the chaos
a low-angle tilt-up from boots to face as the hero rises
a handheld camera that jolts and rolls slightly with the impact
a fast push-in that ends in a crash zoom on the hero's eyes
